results.title: Top - Definition, Meaning & Synonyms | Vocabulary.com
results.content: The highest or uppermost part of something is its *top*, like the *top* rung of a ladder or the *top* bunk of a bunkbed. A top is also a lid, like the top of a soda bottle, an upper rank, like the top position at a law firm, and a child's spinning toy. As a verb, *top* can mean "to beat in a competition," like when you top all of the other contestants in the spelling bee, or "to provide with a topping," like when you top your pie with whipped cream. the upper part of a column that supports the entablature. the head or top of a mast. the part of a tooth above the gum that is covered with enamel. an arrangement of leafy branches forming the top or head of a tree. the top of the head. the top or extreme point of something (usually a mountain or hill). be at the top of or constitute the top or highest point.
